name: Aurora Innovation
sub: Driverless Dallas-Houston freight, scaling to 200+ trucks by 2026
regions: United States Sun Belt freight corridors
about: Autonomous trucking leader with driverless commercial freight operations in Texas and deep OEM / supplier relationships. They shifted from passenger AV breadth toward freight execution.
model: Driver-as-a-service; carrier / freight network partnerships; eventual OEM-integrated trucks
deployment: Driverless commercial ops since April 2025 on Texas corridors incl. the ~1,000-mile Fort Worth–Phoenix lane; a 200-mile Dallas–Oklahoma City lane with Volvo Autonomous Solutions runs five days a week; second OEM fleet (International trucks) from Q2 2026.
metrics: Nearly 440,000 driverless miles by end of June 2026 across 10 Sun Belt routes; second-generation driverless trucks launched 22 July 2026 on the International LT Series, rated for 1M miles at about half the build cost.
signal: Launched second-generation driverless trucks on 22 July 2026; targeting 200+ driverless trucks by end of 2026 and customer truck sales in 2027.

sources.title: Aurora Launches Second-Generation Driverless Trucks in U.S. to Meet Customer Demand
